capabilities: Replace canvas link node auto-loading with a preview thumbnail
Cache thumbnails locally in the plugin data directory
Open the full web page by clicking the thumbnail
extras: Thumbnails are generated only after a first standard page load, so pre-existing and newly created link nodes are not optimized immediately; cached thumbnails live in .obsidian/plugins/canvas-link-optimizer/data and can be safely deleted.
intentEvidence: designed to enhance the user experience with canvas link nodes
motivation: The README lists drawbacks of auto-loading link nodes: performance impact, security concerns, visual distractions, loading delays and unexpected autoplay.
problem: Obsidian Canvas link nodes load full web pages as they come into view, causing high resource usage, security risks, visual distractions and autoplay audio.
summary: Canvas enhancement that replaces auto-loading link nodes with cached page thumbnails to cut CPU, RAM and network use.
